Haryana Government Transfers 30 Senior Police Officers

The Haryana government ordered the transfer of 29 Indian Police Service (IPS) officers and one Haryana Police Service (HPS) officer late at night. The reshuffle involved several district Superintendents of Police (SP), with new officers appointed to Karnal, Bhiwani, Panipat, Narnaul, and Palwal. Ashwin Shenvi was appointed as the Inspector General (IG) for the Karnal range. The transfers were announced through official orders, with lists of the affected officers being circulated.
